provenance.method: Bounded review of current NHS inform counselling/therapy information; retained as a Scotland-specific navigation record.

name: NHS inform therapy and counselling — Scotland
description: NHS inform guidance on counselling and therapy access in Scotland, including NHS, private and voluntary-sector routes.
intended_use: Understanding possible therapy access routes in Scotland without assuming the England Talking Therapies pathway applies.
audience_or_context: People in Scotland exploring counselling or psychological-therapy routes.
limitations: Local NHS pathways, referral requirements and waits vary.
ND Oracle does not assess therapist competence, fit or treatment suitability.
cost_or_access_notes: NHS information is free; private and voluntary-sector services can have different charges.
